Owner-requested site-wide frame refinement on fix/subtle-copper-frames. Shared illustrated cards and top-level working panels use muted aged-copper trim, thinner strokes and offset shadows without orange halos; the footer ornament follows the same treatment in both themes. Hover/focus-within gives a restrained metal highlight. Existing artwork, layout, semantic colours and focus outlines are preserved. The first phase exposed an expired hard-coded Teams test date; the fixture now uses tomorrow in the browser local timezone, with application validation unchanged. Security repairs PR #66 and branding PR #67 are already live; this frame follow-up has not been pushed, merged or deployed. Real OAuth and Stripe lifecycle verification remain owner-deferred.

**Release: NO-GO.** Local implementation, local verification and deployment are separate. No application deployment or provider purchase is authorized by these reports.
